outline.title: 停电后的天文馆 / The Planetarium After the Storm
outline.summary: 暴雨让社区天文馆的控制系统停止工作。Noah、Ms. Rivera、Mina和管理员Dr. Hall没有冒险强行启动设备，而是根据记录、实时读数、已经完成的修复和安全要求逐步排查。团队为传感器测试准备了现实方案和备用方案，最终安全打开穹顶并按时举行活动。

chapters.title: 控制室上锁 / The Locked Control Room
chapters.summary: Noah和Ms. Rivera来到社区天文馆准备晚上的开放活动，却发现控制室被锁住，主电源也在暴雨后停止工作。Noah在旧值班记录中找到备用钥匙的位置，Ms. Rivera联系管理员Dr. Hall确认安全流程，两人进入控制室并发现一只被水浸湿的保险盒。
chapters.knowledgePointRecommendationSummary: Use Past simple to narrate the completed discovery and entry into the control room.

chapters.title: 控制台上的信号 / Signals on the Console
chapters.summary: 控制台重新通电后，指示灯不断闪烁，穹顶却仍然不动。Noah观察此刻正在变化的电压读数，Ms. Rivera对照设备平时的运行规则，发现冷却风扇现在没有转动。两人决定先处理风扇，而不是强行启动穹顶。
chapters.knowledgePointRecommendationSummary: Contrast actions happening now with the console's normal operating behaviour.

chapters.title: 已经完成的修复 / What the Team Has Repaired
chapters.summary: 同学Mina带来干燥工具，三人清理保险盒并重新连接风扇。Noah逐项汇报团队已经完成的修复和仍未解决的问题；Ms. Rivera根据这些最新结果判断主系统可以进入低功率测试，但穹顶传感器仍需要检查。
chapters.knowledgePointRecommendationSummary: Use Present perfect for completed repairs whose results matter to the current test.

chapters.title: 安全测试 / The Safety Test
chapters.summary: Dr. Hall远程说明安全要求：测试前必须清空穹顶轨道，所有人必须站在黄色线外，Noah还需要确认紧急停止按钮。团队逐项完成要求，随后发现一把维修梯仍挡在轨道旁，于是暂停测试并把它移走。
chapters.knowledgePointRecommendationSummary: Use have to and must for external safety requirements and strong necessary actions.

chapters.title: 如果穹顶打开 / If the Dome Opens
chapters.summary: 正式测试前，Noah比较现实方案和假设方案：如果传感器通过，他们就按原计划开放天文馆；如果传感器仍然失败，他们会把活动改成小型星图课。传感器最终通过，穹顶顺利打开，团队保留星图课作为备用方案并按时迎接参观者。
chapters.knowledgePointRecommendationSummary: Use real and hypothetical if-clauses to compare the available plans without changing the confirmed outcome.

args.title: 控制室上锁 / The Locked Control Room
args.cleanText: Noah and Ms. Rivera arrived at the community planetarium at six that evening. Right after the storm, they noticed that the main power was off and the control room was locked. A minute later, Noah found an old duty log, which listed a spare key inside a desk near the entrance. Ms. Rivera called Dr. Hall before they used the key. He confirmed the safety procedure, and they followed each step before entering. Inside, Noah saw water marks beside the controls. They then discovered a wet fuse box below the console and left it untouched until they could bring drying tools.

args.title: 控制台上的信号 / Signals on the Console
args.cleanText: After the fuse box dried, the console came back on, but the dome stayed still. Noah watched the numbers and said, “The voltage is changing right now, and the warning lights are flashing.” Ms. Rivera checked the manual, which explained how the cooling system normally works during a safe startup. She pointed to the fan. “It usually turns before the dome motor starts, but it is not turning at this moment.” Noah recorded the changing readings instead of pressing the start button again. “The console is giving us useful evidence right now,” he said. “So we are choosing the fan first.” They avoided forcing the motor.

args.title: 已经完成的修复 / What the Team Has Repaired
args.cleanText: Mina arrived with dry cloths and other tools. Working together, the three of them cleaned the fuse box and reconnected the fan. Noah then reported their progress: “So far, we have dried the wet area, and we have secured the loose cable. Mina has tested the fan twice, so its latest result is stable.” He added, “The warning lights have stopped flashing, but the dome sensor has not responded up to this point.” Ms. Rivera compared his report with the current readings. “By now, you have collected enough evidence for a low-power test,” she said. “However, we have not completed the sensor check.” The team prepared the test carefully and kept the emergency guide nearby.

args.title: 安全测试 / The Safety Test
args.cleanText: Before the test, Dr. Hall joined them by video and stated the safety requirements. “You have to clear the dome track now, and everyone has to stand behind the yellow line. Noah, you must confirm the emergency stop button now.” The team followed his instructions and checked each area in order. Mina noticed a maintenance ladder beside the track. “We must move that first,” she said. Noah agreed: “The track must be completely clear right now, even if the event begins soon.” They paused the test and carried the ladder away. After another inspection, Ms. Rivera said, “Now the low-power test has to follow the safety procedure, and we still have to watch the safety lights.” Noah stayed near the emergency button.

args.title: 如果穹顶打开 / If the Dome Opens
args.cleanText: Before the final test, Noah compared two realistic plans. “If the sensor passes, we will open the planetarium as planned. If it fails again, we will hold a small star map lesson instead.” Mina arranged the maps as a backup plan. Ms. Rivera added, “If we sacrificed safety just to save time, we would risk the whole event.” The sensor passed, and the dome opened smoothly. Before it moved, Noah repeated, “If the reading goes outside the safe range, we will stop immediately.” It remained stable, so visitors entered on time and looked up at the clear sky. The team kept the star map lesson ready. Mina said, “If the weather changes, we will use it.” Noah added, “If another storm comes, our records will help us respond safely.”
